rollups.text: The user was troubleshooting rapid battery drain on an HP Envy x360. On May 21, 2023, they reported needing to recharge it multiple times a day and wondered whether software was responsible. The assistant suggested checking battery health, updating Windows and system software, adjusting power settings, reviewing startup programs and resource-intensive apps, scanning for malware, reinstalling the battery device in Device Manager, trying System Restore if appropriate, and contacting HP support if the problem continued. The user said they would try the troubleshooting steps; no outcome is recorded. Elapsed time: same day. (May 21, 2023)
